subject: general
question: In which of the following years Indian Oil Corporation was established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1959**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Oil Corporation** was established in the year **1959**.
 
• It is one of the largest commercial enterprises in India and a leading public sector company.
 
• Indian Oil Corporation operates in the field of refining, pipeline transportation, and marketing of petroleum products.
 
• It also has a significant presence in the exploration and production of crude oil and gas, petrochemicals, and alternative energy sources.
 
• The company plays a crucial role in ensuring the energy security of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian Oil Corporation is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
 
• It is the largest commercial oil company in the country, with a significant share of the petroleum products market.
 
• The company has been instrumental in the growth of India's energy sector and has contributed significantly to the nation's economy.
 
• Indian Oil Corporation's R&D center is one of the leading research institutions in the field of oil and gas in Asia.
 
• The company has also ventured into renewable energy sources such as wind, solar, and biofuels to diversify its energy portfolio.
